title: Twitter Backend Clone
desc: Microservices backend in Golang with 4 services communicating over gRPC, Consul for service discovery, RabbitMQ for async event-driven notifications, and distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry/Jaeger.

title: GOTTH Auction
desc: Real-time auction platform in Golang supporting concurrent live auctions with instant bid broadcasting over WebSockets. Each auction runs its own goroutine event loop, replaying full bid history to clients joining mid-auction. Built with HTMX and Templ.

title: VERN - Vehicle Rental
desc: Full-stack vehicle rental platform built for a Web Programming final project. Integrated Google OAuth, Midtrans Payment Gateway, and Mailtrap Email Delivery on the backend.
